FAQ

Does shipping Driving Focus auto-translate my China listing?

No. Driving Focus — the car-driving Focus mode that silences or limits notifications while driving — is an on-device Focus profile — it does not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. How is this different from the generic Focus / Do Not Disturb listing copy?

Generic Focus markets Work, Personal, Sleep, Driving, Fitness, Mindfulness profiles together, Focus Status, Allow Notifications, Silence Notifications, and scheduled Focus — 专注模式 / 勿扰. Driving Focus markets the car-driving Focus profile specifically — auto-activate while driving, silence interruptions on the road — 驾驶专注模式, 开车专注. The driving-specific Focus story is narrower than a multi-profile Focus dump.

How is this different from Reduce Interruptions Focus?

Reduce Interruptions Focus markets the Focus mode that intelligently allows only important interruptions — 减少干扰专注模式. Driving Focus markets silencing or limiting notifications while driving with auto-activation when driving is detected — 驾驶专注模式. Intelligent triage is not silence-on-the-road Driving Focus packaging.

How is this different from Vehicle Motion Cues or Vehicle Detection?

Vehicle Motion Cues markets animated edge dots while riding to reduce car sickness — 车辆运动提示. Vehicle Detection markets Magnifier camera-based vehicle object detection — 车辆检测. Driving Focus markets the car-driving Focus profile for notification silencing while driving — 驾驶专注模式 — not motion-sickness dots or Magnifier vehicle outlines.
